description:
Split an EPUB. With a chapter range (chapterStart and/or chapterEnd) the result is ONE base64-encoded EPUB of exactly those chapters, in order, with the book's metadata, a table of contents limited to them and the fonts and images they use. Without a range the result is a base64-encoded ZIP archive holding one EPUB per chapter.

Free tier: 5MB/file (10MB for pdf-to-epub, 15MB for split), 3 operations/day, 15 req/min, output includes Epublys branding.
Pro ($9/mo): 30MB per operation, unlimited daily operations, 60 req/min, no branding.

When a call is refused with daily_limited or a Pro-only error, call the `upgrade_to_pro` tool — it returns a checkout link to hand the user. Details: https://epublys.com/pricing

chapterStart.description: First chapter to include (1-indexed, optional). Giving either bound returns one EPUB of the range instead of a ZIP

keepMetadata.description: Preserve the original author, publisher and description in the output

name.description: Original filename — the output is named after its stem (e.g. "Book.epub" gives "Book (compressed).epub"); without it the output keeps a fixed name

name: split_epub
